details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: STARTTLS response injection in the smtp transport
     - debian/patches/CVE-2021-38371.patch: fail the TLS session when
       cleartext data was buffered before the STARTTLS handshake
     - CVE-2021-38371
   * SECURITY UPDATE: use-after-free of $regex<n> variables
     - debian/patches/CVE-2022-3559.patch: clear the regex variables on
       every SMTP reset and queue-run message
     - CVE-2022-3559
   * SECURITY UPDATE: memory corruption in string_is_ip_address()
     - debian/patches/CVE-2023-42117.patch: rewrite the IP-address parser
       with bounded checks
     - CVE-2023-42117
   * SECURITY UPDATE: heap out-of-bounds write in JSON dewrap()
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-40685.patch: only skip a backslash that is
       followed by a character
     - CVE-2026-40685
   * SECURITY UPDATE: SPA authenticator out-of-bounds write and heap
     information disclosure
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-40687.patch: zero the decode buffer and
       clamp the unicode/string conversions to their buffers
     - CVE-2026-40687
   * SECURITY UPDATE: use-after-free on TLS close_notify during BDAT
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-45185.patch: keep the BDAT receive layer
       on top of the cleartext functions when TLS input closes
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-45185-2.patch: end the message instead of
       reading on in cleartext when TLS closes mid-message (upstream
       505f9a6a / f285ac8e)
     - CVE-2026-45185
   * SECURITY UPDATE: named-queue directory traversal out of the spool
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-66140.patch: validate queue names and
       make -MC* options admin-only
     - CVE-2026-66140
   * SECURITY UPDATE: .forward privilege escalation via force_command
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-66141.patch: do not expand the pipe
       command local part under force_command
     - CVE-2026-66141
   * SECURITY UPDATE: Proxy-Protocol v1 out-of-bounds write
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-94054.patch: bound the CR search by the
       length of the heap copy of the PROXY line
     - CVE-2026-94054
   * SECURITY UPDATE: Proxy-Protocol v2 uninitialised stack read
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-94056.patch: read until the full 16-byte
       v2 header has arrived and fail on EOF
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-94056-2.patch: fail PROXY reads on peer EOF
       (upstream b327cc6d) and keep PROXYv2 headers with an empty address
       block working (upstream 8751f612)
     - CVE-2026-94056
   * SECURITY UPDATE: Proxy-Protocol v2 uninitialised stack disclosure
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-48840.patch: reject TCPv4 and TCPv6 PROXY
       v2 payloads shorter than their address block
     - CVE-2026-48840
